description: This file defines a React component named `GameCanvas` that manages a canvas element rendering a Mario-like platformer game. It sets up the game loop, handles input, manages game state including level, Mario, enemies, coins, and rendering. It also handles collision detection, game updates, and provides a restart method.

classes.name: GameCanvas
classes.description: A React functional component managing the game rendering and logic for a Mario-style platformer game using HTML5 Canvas.

methods.name: updateWorld
methods.description: Updates game entities (Mario, enemies, coins), handles collisions, respawning, and game over logic on each game tick.

methods.name: renderWorld
methods.description: Renders game elements such as background, solids, coins, enemies, and Mario onto the canvas.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state with a new level and Mario position.
